values.note: Electric (with water) sites $36 a night ($252 a week), full-hookup sites $41 ($287 a week), same in June and August 2027. Plus a daily vehicle pass ($12-17) or annual park pass for every vehicle.

fees.source: cpwshop.com site pages, parkID=50042, North Park loop (sites 630-633 'Electric' '$36.00 /Per Night $252.00 /Per Week'; sites 620-629 'Full Hookup' '$41.00 /Per Night $287.00 /Per Week'; arrivals 06/16/2027 and 08/11/2027) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park ('Daily Vehicle Pass: $12-$17') + camping page ('Visitors are required to display a vehicle pass and have a valid reservation'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: North Park loop: 10 full-hookup and 4 electric-and-water RV sites, gravel, 60 ft (two pull-throughs, 624 and 626; the rest back-in), plus two deluxe cabins. Six people, two vehicles and one camping unit a site.

sites.source: cpwshop.com site pages, parkID=50042 ('Loop: North Park'; sites 620-629 Full Hookup, 630-633 Electric; 'Maximum Vehicle Length: 60'; 'Driveway Entry: Pull-Through' at 624 and 626, 'Back-In' elsewhere; 'Driveway Surface: Gravel') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park/state-forest-state-park-camping-lodging ('Two deluxe cabins are also available at the North Park campground'; 'A maximum of six people, two motorized vehicles and only one camping unit is allowed per individual site'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: The stored showers and laundry came from note prose resting on web listings of the former KOA; CPW's State Forest camping page lists the park's amenities as 'ADA accessibility, Vault toilets, Electrical hook-ups, Dump station, Hand-pumped water and water spigots' and says nothing of showers or laundry at North Park, read 2026-10-28. Cleared.

values.note: Closes for the winter Nov. 1 (CPW's 2026 winter campground closures); the opening date is not posted. Park water is shut off Oct. 31.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park/state-forest-state-park-camping-lodging ('Winter Campground Closures ... Nov. 1 - North Park Campground & Cabins, Bockman & North Michigan'; 'Oct. 31 - Water will be turned off'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservation required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. Maximum 14 days in any 28.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park/state-forest-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at State Forest State Park ... online at cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. note: Colorado Parks and Wildlife campground on CO-14 near Gould, the former Walden KOA, now a loop of State Forest State Park on open sagebrush slopes. --Claude
